title: Towards A Unified Information Bottleneck Framework for Time Series Explanations
abstract: arXiv:2608.25897v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Explaining deep learning models operating on time series data is crucial in various applications that require transparent and interpretable insights into model behavior. {Existing explanation methods generally fall into two categories: attribution-based explanations, which identify the temporal regions most responsible for a prediction, and counterfactual explanations, which reveal how an input should be modified to alter the model's decision.} {Despite valuable insights, these two fields are largely studied independently. This disconnect leaves attribution methods lacking causal validation, while counterfactual methods suffer from severe instability, producing adversarial-like noise instead of meaningful explanations.} In this work, we revisit time-series explainability from an information-theoretic perspective and show that existing explainers are vulnerable to trivial solutions and distributional shifts. translated_title: 面向时间序列解释的统一信息瓶颈框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25897v1 公告类型：新 摘要：解释在时间序列数据上运行的深度学习模型对于需要透明且可解释模型行为的各种应用至关重要。{现有的解释方法通常分为两类：基于归因的解释，识别对预测最负责任的时间区域；以及反事实解释，揭示如何修改输入以改变模型的决策。} {尽管提供了有价值的见解，但这两个领域在很大程度上是独立研究的。这种脱节使得归因方法缺乏因果验证，而反事实方法则遭受严重的不稳定性，产生类似对抗性噪声而非有意义的解释。}在这项工作中，我们从信息论的角度重新审视时间序列可解释性，并表明现有的解释器容易受到平凡解和分布偏移的影响。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种统一的信息瓶颈框架，该框架将归因和反事实解释整合到一个连贯的理论框架中，增强了因果可靠性并缓解了不稳定性问题。
tldr: 提出了一种统一的信息瓶颈框架，将归因和反事实时间序列解释整合起来，解决了现有方法缺乏因果验证和不稳定性的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes a unified information bottleneck framework that integrates attribution and counterfactual time series explanations, addressing the lack of causal validation and instability in existing methods.
